title: Claude Desktop on Windows can execute a project-local git.exe
summary: Claude Desktop on Windows searched the current directory when launching git.exe. A malicious executable in a project could run when that project was opened.

severity.rationale: Opening an attacker-controlled project can execute code with the application's privileges. This common developer interaction makes the flaw high priority, with a project-opening prerequisite.

exposure: Requires a malicious git.exe in a project directory opened in an affected Windows installation.

params.instructions: Check Claude Desktop on Windows against version 1.8089.0. This is a Desktop issue, not a Claude Code CLI version check.

remediation.details: Update Claude Desktop to 1.8089.0 or later. Anthropic says standard auto-updates already delivered the fix.
remediation.risk: Low. Restart and validate project workflows after updating.

verification: Confirm Claude Desktop reports the fixed version or a later patched release.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
